answer_1.quote: We demonstrate the usefulness of our method on two commonsense generation tasks: commonsense explanation generation and abductive commonsense reasoning.

answer_2.quote: We assess the performance of the generated sentences in terms of both diversity and quality. Pairwise Diversity. Self-BLEU ... Distinct-2 ... Entropy-4 ... Quality. BLEU ... ROUGE ...

answer_4.quote: We conducted human evaluation on the outputs produced by our model MoKGE+SAG+OT and the baseline MoKGE for the α-NLG task. We randomly selected 30 generations from each model. The annotation was performed by 3 researchers in the lab. We instructed the annotators to score the diversity and correctness (quality) of each generation on a scale of 0 to 3.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators were instructed to score each generated sentence for diversity and correctness (quality) on a 0‑3 scale.
